landing.title: FairShift - Fair pay, safe work
landing.headline: Know your pay. Speak up safely. Work fair hours.
landing.sub: FairShift helps workers and employers in construction, colleges, hospitals and factories.
landing.workerOtp: Worker sign-in will use a phone OTP. It is not part of this prototype.
landing.demoHint.construction: BuildRight Constructions: sites, scaffolding, daily wages.
landing.demoHint.college: Greenfield College: campus blocks, night security, mess.
landing.demoHint.hospital: CityCare Hospital: ICU, Emergency, night shifts.
landing.feature.pay.title: Clear pay
landing.feature.pay.text: Every rupee on your payslip explained in plain words.
landing.feature.safe.title: Safe reporting
landing.feature.safe.text: Report unsafe work with icons or your voice.
landing.feature.voice.title: Anonymous voice
landing.feature.voice.text: Say what is wrong without giving your name.
landing.feature.rest.title: Rest alerts
landing.feature.rest.text: Warns about too many hours before anyone gets hurt.
landing.feature.skills.title: Skill passport
landing.feature.skills.text: Your training goes with you to the next job.
landing.feature.lang.title: Your language
landing.feature.lang.text: English, Hindi and Tamil, with read-aloud.
landing.industry.construction.1: Scan the site QR to mark attendance.
landing.industry.construction.2: Report loose scaffolding or missing helmets.
landing.industry.construction.3: Get alerts before a working-at-height certificate ends.
landing.industry.college.who: Housekeeping, security, lab and mess staff.
landing.industry.college.1: Night security shifts counted correctly across midnight.
landing.industry.college.2: Report wet floors and blocked fire exits.
landing.industry.college.3: Lab safety certificates tracked with end dates.
landing.industry.hospital.who: Nurses and ward staff on day and night shifts.
landing.industry.hospital.1: Check in by department with a daily QR or code.
landing.industry.hospital.2: Report needle-stick injuries, patient aggression or faulty equipment.
landing.industry.hospital.3: Alerts for too many night shifts and too little rest after nights.
landing.more: The same app can serve factories too: only the settings change, not the code.
landing.footer: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth. Prototype for Prompt Wars 2026 x SRM ACM.
